## Summary
Eliminate all `unsafe` blocks from the codebase while preserving existing functionality and features.

## Requirements
- Identify all instances of `unsafe` code in the project
- Refactor each unsafe block to use safe Rust alternatives
- Maintain identical behavior and feature set
- Ensure no performance regressions for critical paths
- Update any related documentation or comments

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No `unsafe` keyword appears in any source files (excluding dependencies)
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] No functional regressions introduced
- [ ] Code compiles without warnings
- [ ] Any performance-critical sections maintain comparable performance
